candidates.change_summary: Change the overflow check condition so it always passes, potentially causing unintended overflow/state corruption on receive.
Replace the overflow check with a condition that always fails, making the receive function revert on every call.
Remove the require statement, allowing depositsCount to overflow without any check.
Remove the depositsCount increment, so depositsCount never changes after receive.
Replace the increment with a decrement, so depositsCount decreases instead of increasing.
Replace the increment with a larger increment (e.g., +2), breaking the expected one-to-one deposit counter.
Delete the require statement in withdrawAll, removing the onlyOwner modifier's effect, so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a no-op, so withdrawAll does not transfer funds.
Insert a revert before the withdraw, so withdrawAll always fails.
Delete the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw(uint256), making it callable by anyone.
Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(true), allowing anyone to pass the onlyOwner check.
